lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 4-5 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular geometric grid posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs to form a visible grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature displaying a sharp light-to-dark vertical pixel gradient located on the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct commensal fish silhouettes; one positioned near the base of the right pectoral fin and one further below the ventral midline.
